scope: One parameter table for the fourteen selected finite bands and four coordinate exclusions. Lean checks positivity only; no recorded HS tail bound is assumed.

provenance.bound: Text representation of an outward Arb enclosure produced by the historical program; not a Lean theorem.
provenance.upper_rational: Exact rational conversion of the upper endpoint of that Arb enclosure. It is recorded provenance and is not used as an assumed HS bound by this generator or Lean module.
provenance.approx: Floating midpoint diagnostic, never used in Lean.
provenance.decomposition_sha256: Hash of the historical angular decomposition read by certify_power_hs.py. The decomposition files are not committed in this parameter-only batch; no decomposition or HS identity is inferred from the hashes.
provenance.historical_source_path: The absolute /private/tmp source field is immutable historical metadata. Current generation reads only committed hash-pinned inputs and does not access that path.
provenance.selection: For power1, D51 and D101 use rectangular_hs_result.json; D151,D161,D171,D181 use power1_hs_result.json. Power2 D101 and rectangular power1 D151 are not selected in the Lean table. All raw inputs remain byte-identical. No tail bound is transferred between different parameter choices.
